description: This source file is part of a Git implementation module focused on handling pack objects and their geometrical arrangement for optimization. It includes functions for initializing, splitting, and choosing packs based on size and progression criteria, as well as removing redundant packs.

methods.name: uint32_t pack_geometry_weight(struct packed_git * p)
methods.description: Calculates the weight of a pack, based on the number of objects, after opening the pack's index.

methods.name: int pack_geometry_cmp(const void * va,const void * vb)
methods.description: Comparator function that orders packs by their weight for sorting purposes.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_init(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct existing_packs * existing,const struct pack_objects_args * args)
methods.description: Initializes a pack_geometry structure by collecting relevant pack files based on criteria such as localness and keep flags.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_split(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Divides packs into segments based on size progression, aiming to optimize pack sizes through geometric progression.

methods.name: struct:packed_git * pack_geometry_preferred_pack(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Selects the preferred pack, usually the largest pack outside the split zone, for further operations.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_remove_redundant(struct pack_geometry * geometry,struct string_list * names,struct existing_packs * existing,const char * packdir)
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the geometry based on a list of names and existing kept packs.

methods.name: void pack_geometry_release(struct pack_geometry * geometry)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a pack_geometry structure.
